verified_facts.text: Casa Baglioni Milan is in the Brera district of Milan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casa Baglioni Milan is situated in the artistic Brera district.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's design is inspired by the art and design of 1960s Milan, mixing traditional Italian style with modern innovation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the art & design of 1960s Milan, the hotel mixes traditional Italian style and modern innovation, with simple, linear, geometric shapes & vivid colors.

verified_facts.text: Room decor includes lighting by Panzeri, wallpaper by Rubelli, fabrics by Dedar and fittings by Zucchetti.
verified_facts.excerpt: The decor includes lighting by Panzeri, wallpaper by Rubelli, fabrics by Dedar & taps/fittings by Zucchetti

verified_facts.text: The hotel's Wine Cellar can be booked for private tastings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Wine Cellar houses a prestigious selection of premier Italian and international labels to please the most discerning palates. You can arrange for private tastings.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop serves drinks and aperitivo with panoramic views of Milan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come up to the Rooftop for drinks, gourmet aperitivo & panoramic views of Milan.

verified_facts.text: The suites feature inlaid wood floors and geometric shapes and colors typical of the Spatialist avant-garde movement.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our stunning suites are characterized by inlaid wood floors, satin-finish fabrics & geometric shapes and colors typical of the Spatialist, avant-garde movement.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Suite is a tribute to Italian craftsmanship and Gio Ponti's Milan.
verified_facts.excerpt: A hymn to the excellence of Italian craftsmanship and Giò Ponti’s Milan

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have balconies with views of the Brera district.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some rooms offer balconies with views of the Brera district.

verified_facts.text: Small and medium-sized pets are welcome for a per-stay supplement.
verified_facts.excerpt: We welcome small/medium-sized pets (max of 15 kilos/33 lbs.) A supplement of 50€ ($54 USD) per stay will be applied.

verified_facts.text: Suite bathroom amenities are by Acqua di Parma.
The fitness center is equipped with Technogym machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay fit during your stay courtesy of our state-of-the-art facility, which is equipped with the latest technogym machines.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a tour of the Brera district including the Pinacoteca di Brera.
verified_facts.excerpt: Casa Baglioni invites you to discover the artistic heart of Milan with an exclusive tour of the Brera District—its own neighborhood. Stroll charming streets, browse art galleries, and explore the Pinacoteca di Brera

verified_facts.text: Experiences offered include a private Lake Como trip from Milan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience a refined, private Lake Como trip from Milan.

verified_facts.text: The hotel occupies a townhouse built in the 1910s that once belonged to fashion designer Philipp Plein.
verified_facts.excerpt: This 1910s-built townhouse once belonged to fashion designer Philipp Plein, and was the perfect, refined space for Baglioni to take over.

verified_facts.text: The lobby's neon-strip chandelier nods to Lucio Fontana-designed light fittings at the Museo del Novecento.
verified_facts.excerpt: you’re greeted first by the neon-strip swirly chandelier, a nod to the Lucio Fontana-designed light fittings at Museo del Novecento

verified_facts.text: Rooms are done in chestnut wood with midcentury sofas and armchairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms are all chestnut wood with curves to die for and artful shelving; midcentury sofas and armchairs

verified_facts.text: Chef Claudio Sadler's cooking at the hotel reinvents regional Milanese traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chef Sadler blends the elegant dynamism of Milan, reinventing regional traditions with unmistakable style

verified_facts.text: Claudio Sadler's tasting menu includes Milanese dishes such as risotto Milanese, veal and local cheese.
verified_facts.excerpt: His cooking is particularly Milanese; even on the tasting menu, you get a hint of the city’s unsung food culture: risotto Milanese, veal, and local cheese.
